title.narrative: Capacity strengthing for more accountable operations

description.narrative: APROFIM is a female-lead organization that works to support disadvantaged children, specially young girls that have been affected in one way or another by some sort of crisis (ie rape, teenage mothers, street children, girls accused to be sorcerer) to be reintegrated in their society. APROFIM is a sub grantee of the Poticus grant and the organization operates under the coverage of CAJED. However, recent comments from the funding agency that also came about in consideration of the current funding trends recommended that a comprehensive capacity strengthening plan to be put forward in order to position APROFIM in the forefront of not only CAFOD but more in the market to attract other funding agencies. Also as part of CAFOD requirements, APROFIM was also taken though the Mango Health Check, an exercise that is a must for all institutionally funded project. The report from this exercise confirmed the need to strengthen the organization's capacity in some areas although they were situated in low risk. In February 2019, AFROFIME participated to the PDMEAL workshop organised by CAFOD. Just like other partners, APROFIME made their self-capacity assessment regarding PDMEAL and safeguarding. As a result of this, they have developed a capacity strengthening plan. This grant aim to take materialize the action points and recommendations coming from these assessments including: - Support in establishing of feedback and complaint mechanism - support the development of 5 years Strategic plan of the organisation - Strengthen the advocacy plan of the organization that is evidence based ie Production of booklet of success stories of its beneficiaries, especially the one supported through CAFOD partnership
